official.deadline_note: No scholarship application deadline exists - the scholarship page states "You don't need to apply for this scholarship" and "We will let you know the deadline for accepting your scholarship offer" once an offer is issued. The operative deadline is the UQ program application closing date (Semester 1: 30 November of the previous year; Semester 2: 31 May of the same year).
official.application_cycle: 2027 intake - "the UQ International Excellence Scholarship for international students commencing in 2027"
official.status_note: Published for the 2027 intake for future international students. There is no application round to enter: applicants are assessed automatically from their UQ program application, and the offer is issued with the unconditional letter of offer.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Scholarship value is published as "25% reduction in tuition fees per semester"; UQ states "If you're awarded the scholarship, the 25% tuition fee reduction will be applied prior to the tuition fees due date each semester." The 2027 terms and conditions word the same value as "a tuition fee reduction of 25% per annum for the duration of the enrolled coursework program." No living-cost, travel or other allowance is published.
benefits: Scholarship value: 25% reduction in tuition fees per semester
The Scholarship is a tuition fee reduction of 25% per annum for the duration of the enrolled coursework program
The 25% tuition fee reduction is applied prior to the tuition fees due date each semester
eligibility: Be an international student (not an Australian or New Zealand Citizen or Australian Permanent Resident)
Have applied to study full-time at UQ commencing in 2027 in a relevant program and have satisfied all the conditions of the program offer
Have satisfied the program entry rank and English language proficiency requirements, and will enrol full time (8 units per semester unless otherwise required according to a study plan)
Have achieved a competitive score as determined by the University among the pool of offer holders for programs in their commencement semester
Have not received another scholarship, tuition fee reduction or rebate from UQ (excluding the UQ English Language Scholarship)
Have not received a full scholarship/sponsorship from another organisation (applicants with partial scholarships/sponsorships may be considered)
requirements: Must have an Unconditional offer for the relevant coursework program, or have satisfied all conditions of the Conditional Offer
Must accept the UQ program offer and make the tuition deposit payment for the scholarship to be confirmed
Must maintain full-time enrolment in a relevant coursework program (8 units per semester unless otherwise required according to a study plan)
Must maintain satisfactory academic progress for the duration of the program
Must accept the scholarship offer by the deadline UQ specifies in the offer
documents: UQ program application (no separate scholarship application is required)
Evidence of satisfying the program entry rank requirement, supplied through the program application
Evidence of English language proficiency as required by the program
Acceptance of the UQ program offer and payment of the tuition deposit
selection_criteria: A competitive score as determined by the University among the pool of offer holders for programs in their commencement semester
The University reserves the right to withdraw a scholarship offer and/or adjust the requirements for scholarship eligibility and selection timeframe at its discretion
coverage: Tuition fees only - a 25% reduction applied before the tuition fees due date each semester
Published purpose: to provide assistance with tuition fees for high achieving international students
application_method: You don't need to apply for this scholarship. When you apply to study a program at UQ, you're automatically assessed for this scholarship.
An applicant will automatically be considered for the Scholarship if they meet the eligibility criteria in section 4 of the terms and conditions
International students apply online via UQ's application portal or through an authorised UQ agent
official.application_route: No separate application - submit the standard UQ program application; assessment is automatic and the award is notified with the unconditional letter of offer
official.study_mode: Full-time (8 units per semester unless otherwise required according to a study plan)
official.citizenship_residency: International student means a student who is not an Australian or New Zealand Citizen or Australian Permanent Resident
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is open only to international students
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Must be a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program of at least 16 units, excluding a published list of programs including medicine, dentistry, nursing, midwifery, physiotherapy, psychology, pharmacy, dietetics, nutrition, audiology, biostatistics, veterinary science, sports medicine and the Master of Business Administration
official.duration: For the duration of the program (the duration of the enrolled coursework program)
official.description: The UQ International Excellence Scholarship is funded by The University of Queensland and its published purpose is to provide assistance with tuition fees for high achieving international students commencing a relevant coursework program at UQ in 2027. It provides a 25% reduction in tuition fees per semester for the duration of the enrolled coursework program, awarded automatically without a separate application.
official.english_requirement: Must have satisfied the program entry rank and English language proficiency requirements.

verification.notes: Value, duration, eligibility, no-application route and 25% tuition reduction taken from UQ's own scholarship page and the official 2027 terms and conditions PDF (both on scholarships.uq.edu.au); program application closing dates from study.uq.edu.au; living-cost ranges from UQ's cost-of-living page. The scholarship page describes the reduction as 'per semester' while the TCs say '25% per annum' - both recorded verbatim.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a tuition discount, not a cash award: UQ takes 25% off your tuition fees for the whole program, and it is decided automatically after your program offer becomes unconditional. Because there is no application form, your only levers are applying early for a 2027 start and clearing every condition of your offer quickly, since the reduction is confirmed only once you accept the offer and pay the tuition deposit. Budget it as a fee offset - the remaining 75% of tuition, all living costs, flights and health cover stay on you, with UQ's own guidance putting off-campus living at roughly A$1,326-$3,739 per month and catered St Lucia colleges from A$633 per week.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international coursework applicants (undergraduate or 16+ unit postgraduate) with strong academic results who want a program-wide discount on UQ tuition rather than a stipend.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit your UQ program application well before the Semester 1 2027 closing date of 30 November 2026 - the scholarship rides entirely on that application
Clear every condition of your conditional offer (academic documents, English evidence) as fast as possible; the scholarship offer is not released until the offer is unconditional
Have the tuition deposit ready to pay as soon as the scholarship offer arrives - the discount is only confirmed after the deposit

Check your chosen program against the excluded list in the 2027 TCs (medicine, dentistry, nursing, physiotherapy, psychology, pharmacy, dietetics, biostatistics, MBA and similar) before relying on the discount
Confirm your study plan meets the full-time load of 8 units per semester
common_rejection_risks: Missing the program closing date - there is no scholarship deadline to chase, so anyone who applies after the round closes is never assessed
Holding a full scholarship or sponsorship from another organisation, which the TCs make disqualifying
Already holding any other UQ scholarship, tuition fee reduction or rebate (the UQ English Language Scholarship is the only exception)
Deferring commencement or changing program after the offer - both trigger re-evaluation and can void the award
Dropping below full-time enrolment or failing satisfactory academic progress, which terminates the scholarship
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 75% of tuition fees, all living costs (UQ guidance: roughly A$1,326-$3,739 per month off campus, or from A$633 per week in a catered St Lucia college), flights, student visa fees and Overseas Student Health Cover.
document_audit: The evidence for your program-offer conditions (final transcripts, English test results) must be verified quickly - the scholarship offer is held back until they are
Keep the scholarship offer letter: it names the exact program and commencement semester the 25% applies to
Your tuition deposit payment is effectively the scholarship acceptance document, so retain the receipt
No essays, references, budget statements or research proposal are required - do not build an application packet that has no reviewer
alerts: For a Semester 1 2027 start the program application closes 30 November 2026 - roughly seven weeks from this verification date - after which automatic consideration stops
The scholarship offer and the program offer arrive together, and UQ states it will advise the acceptance deadline with that offer - act on it immediately

The scholarship page says the 25% applies 'per semester' while the 2027 TCs say '25% per annum'; confirm the exact dollar effect in writing with iasscholarships@uq.edu.au before declining other funding
Deferral means re-evaluation against a new semester's applicant pool, so a stronger cohort can cost you the discount
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the UQ program application through the portal or an authorised agent, satisfy all conditions of the offer, receive the scholarship offer with the unconditional offer, then accept and pay the tuition deposit - after which the 25% reduction is applied before each semester's tuition due date.
